name: Thela Stock Manager
changelog: v4.1.0: Lean POS Cockpit Edition: (1) Streamlined 100vh Zero-Scroll layout by retiring redundant stepper controls and party name/notes, (2) Direct two-tier quantity selection (1-tap preset chips 25/50/100/200/500 + on-screen numeric keypad), (3) 100% pure physical bag inventory tracking with maximum speed, zero friction, and full backwards compatibility.
